  • Ensure Data Integrity and Compliance: Maintain accuracy, consistency, and traceability of all GIS data edits and updates across the enterprise environment.

  • Collaborate: Work closely with GIS analysts, database administrators, and developers to ensure smooth integration, performance optimization, and scalability of QA/QC solutions.



Qualifications



  • Bachelor’s degree in Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Computer Science, Geomatics , or a related field.

  • Proven experience in Python scripting for GIS automation .

  • Strong knowledge of Esri technologies , including ArcGIS Pro, ArcGIS Enterprise , and ArcGIS Workflow Manager .

  • Experience with ArcPy and/or the ArcGIS API for Python .

  • Understanding of spatial data models, topology rules, and coordinate systems .

  • Familiarity with data quality management principles (QA/QC) in GIS environments.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.

  • Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a collaborative environment.



Preferred Qualifications



  • Experience with versioned geodatabases (ArcSDE) and enterprise data workflows.

  • Exposure to SQL and spatial database management.

  • Knowledge of automation frameworks or DevOps practices within GIS.



What You’ll Achieve


You’ll play a key role in building a repeatable, automated, and auditable quality-control process for spatial data—ensuring every dataset and map product meets enterprise accuracy standards before publication or approval.

title: Channel Agencies Director
description:
Overview

Nosso time de Channel Agencies

A Nuvemshop é a principal plataforma de e-commerce da América Latina, com o propósito de potencializar o sucesso de empreendedores e marcas em todos os estágios de crescimento. Nosso ecossistema conta com mais de 2.000 parceiros especialistas , que oferecem serviços de design, marketing, tecnologia e performance para ajudar lojistas a crescerem seus negócios.

Nosso ecossistema de agências parceiras especializadas é um dos principais pilares de aquisição, ativação e sucesso dos nossos clientes — contribuindo diretamente para o crescimento sustentável do negócio e para a consolidação da marca Nuvemshop como a plataforma preferencial do mercado.

A área de Channel Agencies é responsável por desenvolver, gerir e potencializar o desempenho dessas agências, que representam um canal estratégico de receita e diferenciação competitiva. Buscamos um(a) Diretor(a) de Channel Agencies com visão estratégica, profundidade de negócios e forte capacidade de liderança para acelerar o impacto e a maturidade do canal no Brasil.

O tamanho do seu desafio

Channel Agencies é o canal de aquisição de parceiros e merchants, com maior investimento e crescimento nos próximos anos. O(a) Diretor(a) de Channel Agencies deve definir e liderar a estratégia de crescimento, excelência e rentabilidade do canal de agências da Nuvemshop, maximizando o valor entregue aos clientes, a performance das agências parceiras e o retorno financeiro à companhia.

Essa Posição Tem Responsabilidade Direta Sobre o P&L Do Canal De Agências, e Liderança / Influência Transversal Sobre Áreas Como Marketing, Growth, Product, Revenue Excellence e Operations, Atuando Como Guardião Da Estratégia Integrada Entre Produto, Go-to-market e Geração De Demanda.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Liderar e desenvolver as estruturas de Channel Agencies, tanto de clientes e agências SMB, como Mid-market, garantindo coesão estratégica, eficiência operacional e excelência na gestão de portfólio de agências;
  • Ser responsável pelo P&L do canal, assegurando crescimento sustentável, rentabilidade e previsibilidade de resultados;
  • Orquestrar a visão de produto e experiência do parceiro, em alinhamento com Revenue Excellence e Product, assegurando que o roadmap reflita as necessidades estratégicas das agências e de seus clientes;
  • Supervisionar a área de Demand Generation for Partners, responsável por co-marketing, campanhas integradas e eventos de engajamento, impulsionando geração de leads tanto para agências quanto para a Nuvemshop;
  • Liderar o marketplace de agências, otimizando a conexão entre merchants e parceiros certificados e garantindo excelência em toda a jornada — da descoberta à conversão e retenção;
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com Marketing, Product Marketing e Customer Success para coordenar a jornada do cliente dentro da plataforma, promovendo uma transição fluida e de alto impacto entre a Nuvemshop e as agências;
  • Construir e sustentar relacionamentos estratégicos com lideranças de agências, posicionando a Nuvemshop como a principal plataforma de negócios para seus clientes;
  • Influenciar e alinhar equipes de marketing, eventos, operações e program management, assegurando consistência e execução integrada de todas as frentes relacionadas ao canal;
  • Evoluir o playbook de Channel Agencies, definindo frameworks de crescimento, sucesso e engajamento baseados em benchmarks (Shopify, HubSpot, Salesforce, RD Station), mas com a cultura e DNA Nuvemshop;
  • Ser o principal porta-voz da estratégia de agências internamente, traduzindo insights de mercado, comportamento dos parceiros e tendências emergentes em decisões de negócio e roadmap.

O que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência em liderança executiva, idealmente em programas de canais e agências em empresas SaaS, plataformas digitais ou de tecnologia;
  • Histórico comprovado de gestão de P&L, crescimento de receita e estruturação de operações escaláveis de parceiros;
  • Visão estratégica ampla, com forte capacidade de integração entre negócios, produto e marketing, traduzindo objetivos corporativos em planos táticos de alto impacto;
  • Perfil de liderança inspiradora, capaz de engajar e alinhar times multifuncionais sob uma visão unificada de crescimento;
  • Elevada capacidade analítica e domínio de gestão por dados e indicadores de performance;
  • Experiência comprovada em negociação e relacionamento em nível executivo, com parceiros estratégicos e stakeholders internos;
  • Fluência em inglês.

Diferenciais

  • Experiência no mercado de e-commerce;
  • Conhecimento profundo do mercado de agências digitais e de performance;
  • Vivência em gestão de programa de parceiros;
  • Histórico de transformação de programas de parceria em motores de crescimento previsível e escalável.

Nosso processo

Queremos que você tenha a melhor experiência possível ao longo do nosso processo seletivo. Após a sua inscrição, o time de Talent Acquisition irá analisar seu perfil com atenção e, independentemente do resultado, você receberá um retorno. As etapas e prazos podem variar de acordo com cada vaga, mas não se preocupe — que nos manteremos em contato com você.

O que temos para você

  • Plano de Saúde, Plano Odontológico e Seguro de Vida;
  • Flash Benefícios: Plataforma que reúne vale alimentação, vale refeição e outras categorias como educação, entretenimento, cultura, saúde, bem-estar, auxílio home office e muito mais;
  • Aulas de espanhol semanais gratuitas;
  • Totalpass: As melhores redes de parcerias para atividades físicas, mindfulness, terapia, nutrição e qualidade do sono, com diversos planos disponíveis;
  • Descontos nos cursos da Coderhouse;
  • Auxílio creche para crianças de até 5 anos;
  • Licença de família estendida para 21 dias corridos para pessoas não grávidas ou adotantes. A licença maternidade é de 4 meses e a licença parental de 21 dias. O benefício também vale para famílias que adotarem ou obtiverem a guarda judicial da criança e para casais homoafetivos;
  • Além das férias, temos uma semana de descanso para recarregar as energias no final/começo do ano;
  • Uma Nuvemshop gratuita para você ou pessoa próxima;
  • Somos #remotefirst - o que significa que damos prioridade ao trabalho remoto dentro do país de contratação, sempre que a função permitir;
  • E um ambiente de desafio contínuo, propósito e protagonismo — aqui você é livre para pensar grande e ter atitude gigante.

Política de Privacidade de Dados

A Nuvemshop está comprometida em proteger a privacidade e garantir a segurança dos dados pessoais das pessoas candidatas às vagas que ofertamos.

Para dar seguimento com a sua candidatura, teremos acesso a alguns dados pessoais seus e gostaríamos de repassar algumas informações antes de você continuar. Utilizaremos tais dados para conduzirmos os processos que envolvem o recrutamento e a seleção. Além disso, cuidamos dos seus dados pessoais de forma muito séria e só os compartilhamos com quem realmente precisa. Por fim, somente iremos mantê-los em nosso sistema pelo tempo realmente necessário.

Para saber mais sobre a forma pela qual tratamos seus dados, inclusive dos seus direitos previstos em lei, basta acessar a nossa Política de Privacidade.

title: Medico Neurologista - Telemedicina
description:
Resumo

Realizar consultas online para avaliação, diagnóstico e acompanhamento de doenças neurológicas.

Responsabilidades

  • Atender pacientes com sintomas como dor de cabeça crônica, tontura, tremores, dormência, formigamento e confusão mental.
  • Diagnosticar e tratar condições neurológicas, como enxaqueca, epilepsia, AVC, neuropatias, esclerose múltipla, doença de Parkinson e distúrbios do sono.
  • Solicitar e interpretar exames complementares, como ressonância magnética, eletroneuromiografia, polissonografia e exames laboratoriais.
  • Prescrever tratamentos medicamentosos e orientar terapias complementares, conforme diretrizes médicas e necessidade do paciente.
  • Fornecer orientações sobre reabilitação neurológica, qualidade do sono, controle do estresse e prevenção de doenças neurológicas.
  • Identificar necessidade de encaminhamento para atendimento presencial, quando exames físicos ou procedimentos forem essenciais.
  • Registrar todas as informações no prontuário eletrônico, garantindo um histórico clínico completo e seguro. CRM ativo e regularizado no Brasil;

Requisitos / Qualificações

  • Registro de especialidade requerida (RQE);
  • Experiência com telemedicina será um diferencial;
  • Habilidade para conduzir consultas humanizadas e resolutivas.

description:
Sr Director, Client Results

This position will provide leadership and direction for the day to day operations of account(s).

The Purpose of Your Role

The Senior Director of Client Results is responsible for overall operations and operational performance. The Senior Director will be the senior point of contact for day-to-day management of the business; the ability to offer solutions and new ideas to promote program success, revenue growth, and profitability. He/she will be responsible for overseeing the management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. The Senior Client Results Director will direct and supervise the development and execution of performance strategies to maximize results. He / she will work cross-functionally and direct all necessary support initiatives for accounts. Leadership will need to be tactical with a key emphasis on maximizing KPI, customer care, quality assurance, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, and training.

The Qualifications We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of work experience required
  • 10 + years of contact center/BPO experience
  • 6 years prior multi-level management experience
  • Proven demonstrable track record of success
  • Team player able to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills in a team environment
  • Experience with interacting and influencing clients’ outcomes
  • Executive Presence
  • Strong Organizational, multi-tasking, time management skills

Job Title: Smartsheet Solution Architect

Duration: 6-12 months

Overview

We are seeking a highly experienced and certified Smartsheet Solution Architect & PMO Leader to drive the strategic design, implementation, and optimization of our work management and Project Portfolio Management (PPM) solutions. This is a critical leadership role for an individual who not only understands Smartsheet at an architectural level but can also establish and mature enterprise-wide Project Management Office (PMO) standards and capabilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong eye for design and user experience, able to provide expert guidance on sheet layout, structure, and visual presentation to ensure optimal usability and engagement.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and Architect Solutions: Lead the end-to-end architectural design and development of complex, integrated Smartsheet solutions, including utilizing premium applications like Control Center, Resource Management, and Dynamic View, to meet Gordian's strategic business needs.
  • Platform Optimization: Act as the Smartsheet expert and Administrator , continuously optimizing the platform for performance, scalability, and user experience.
  • Governance and Standards: Establish and enforce Smartsheet governance, best practices, and standardization for dashboards, reporting, automation, and data integrity across the organization.
  • Stakeholder Mobilization: Introduce and drive adoption of the Smartsheet platform and its capabilities across all levels of company leadership.
  • Design Excellence: Provide expert consultation on the visual design and structural layout of sheets , dashboards, and reports, ensuring they are intuitive, aesthetically pleasing, and aligned with user experience best practices.
  • PMO Implementation: Establish, lead, and mature the PMO function —defining, documenting, and implementing project management standards, best practices, and procedures (PMP methodologies).
  • PPM Tool Implementation: Establish and lead the use of Smartsheet as the primary PPM tool for enterprise-wide intake, demand, and resource management, portfolio management, and real‑time status reporting.
  • Strategic Alignment: Charter and lead executive-level bodies, such as a Steering Committee or Project Review Board (PRB), to ensure project and program portfolios are aligned with strategic goals and organizational objectives.
  • Process Improvement: Drive measurable improvements in project delivery metrics, such as increasing on‑time completion rates and enhancing strategic focus through effective prioritization methods.

Required Skills & Qualifications

Experience

  • Progressive leadership experience in Project Management, Program Management, and/or PMO Director roles.
  • Expert‑level experience in Smartsheet development, configuration, and administration, with a proven track record of implementing the platform in multiple corporate environments.
  • Demonstrated experience in establishing, leading, and maturing a corporate PMO from the ground up, including hiring and managing a team of Project Managers, Business Analysts, and Scrum Masters.
  • Experience managing multiple project portfolios (e.g., infrastructure, application development) valued over $10M each and managing over 300 concurrent projects.
  • Experience in change management and successfully integrating new processes and teams following acquisitions or mergers.
  • Design sensibility and UX expertise with the ability to evaluate and provide constructive feedback on sheet design, layout optimization, color schemes, formatting, and overall visual presentation to enhance usability and user adoption.

Certifications

  • Smartsheet Certified Solution Consultant (Highly preferred)
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) (Essential)
  • Certified Change Management Professional (CCMP) (Preferred)

Education & Logistics

  • Education: Master’s degree in project management or a related field is highly desirable
  • Work Hours: This role will primarily operate on Eastern Standard Time (EST) hours to align with company operations.
  • Location: Remote

description:
A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Responsabilidades

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais

  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

title: Coordenadora Administrativa-Financeira Pleno
description:
CANDIDATURA

As pessoas interessadas deverão enviar carta de motivação, compartilhando o seu interesse em trabalhar na Empodera e currículo, ambos em PDF, para ****** , com assunto "Coordenadora Adm-Fin Pleno", até as 23h59 do dia 31/08/2025. As candidaturas que não cumprirem essas especificações serão desconsideradas.

Sobre a posição

A coordenadora administrativa-financeira pleno é a responsável, juntamente com a gestão executiva, por analisar, gerenciar e implementar sistemas e processos administrativos e financeiros eficientes e transparentes na organização. Ela coordena e acompanha a equipe da área, elabora orçamentos e relatórios de prestação de contas, controla fluxo de caixa e conciliações bancárias, e desenvolve processos integrados que aumentam a eficiência e a eficácia da organização, num ambiente empreendedor e colaborativo.

Vaga exclusiva para mulheres (cis/trans). A Empodera incentiva fortemente a candidatura de mulheres negras, indígenas, vivendo com HIV/AIDS, LBTI+ e com deficiência.

Quem somos

Fundada em 2017, a Empodera – Transformação Social pelo Esporte é uma associação civil sem fins lucrativos com sede no Rio de Janeiro e atuação nacional, que utiliza o esporte e jogos lúdicos para que meninas adolescentes em situação de vulnerabilidade social exerçam seu pleno potencial e direitos. A organização foca na redução de estereótipos nocivos e violência baseada no gênero e trabalha com desenvolvimento e execução de metodologias esportivas, treinamentos e suporte técnico de organizações em prol de uma sociedade mais justa e equânime.

Responsabilidades Principais

FINANCEIRO – OPERAÇÕES (40%)

  • Gerenciar o fluxo de caixa organizacional
  • Supervisionar as operações financeiras diárias – contabilidade, contas a pagar/receber, salários, obrigações fiscais
  • Analisar e apresentar relatórios financeiros de maneira precisa e oportuna; comunicar claramente as demonstrações financeiras mensais e anuais
  • Elaborar relatórios financeiros para prestação de contas e supervisionar a contabilidade financeira, de projetos/programas e doações
  • Fornecer informações financeiras em tempo hábil e preciso
  • Supervisionar e liderar a elaboração do orçamento organizacional anual e planejamento financeiro em conjunto com a diretora executiva; monitorar progresso e mudanças
  • Realizar conciliações bancárias de acordo com o fluxo de pagamento semanal
  • Emitir notas fiscais de acordo com obrigações legais e fiscais

FINANCEIRO – GESTÃO DE PROGRAMAS (20%)

  • Manter comunicação frequente com as coordenadoras de projetos para análise dos gastos (reais x orçados)
  • Apresentar a prestação de contas dos projetos nos prazos estipulados
  • Fornecer relatórios financeiros mensais às coordenadoras de projetos, incluindo gastos por centro de custo/projeto
  • Auxiliar na elaboração de orçamentos para editais
  • Garantir que a organização atenda aos requisitos externos dos doadores
  • Comunicar com parceiros sobre o andamento financeiro dos programas

FINANCEIRO – COMPLIANCE (15%)

  • Atualizar e implementar todas as políticas e procedimentos financeiros necessários
  • Coordenar e liderar eventuais processos de auditoria
  • Supervisionar a produção do relatório financeiro anual
  • Examinar documentos financeiros e legais para garantir aderência aos regulamentos e princípios financeiros
  • Garantir o uso eficaz e transparente dos recursos financeiros em conformidade com políticas internas e de parceiros

RECURSOS HUMANOS E DEMAIS ATIVIDADES (15%)

  • Coordenar, acompanhar e colaborar no desenvolvimento da equipe
  • Garantir que folha de pagamento mensal, pagamento de benefícios e manutenção de registros sejam executados de maneira eficiente
  • Garantir a conformidade com a legislação trabalhista local
  • Participar de treinamentos internos e externos sobre temas relacionados à função e aos programas desenvolvidos pela organização

ADMINISTRATIVO – (10%)

  • Coordenar as atividades administrativas da área/equipe
  • Aprimorar e elaborar processos administrativos e políticas internas
  • Supervisionar os processos administrativos, em conformidade com as políticas e procedimentos adotados pela Empodera
  • Orientar a equipe em relação aos procedimentos administrativos e financeiros

FORMAÇÃO, EXPERIÊNCIA E HABILIDADES NECESSÁRIAS

  • Formação: Nível superior completo, com preferência para as áreas de ciências contábeis, administração, economia
  • Conhecimentos avançados do pacote Office, especialmente Excel
  • Minimo de 3 anos de experiência em rotinas administrativas, financeira, contábeis e de pessoal (fluxo de caixa, contas a pagar e receber, orçamento, conciliação bancária)
  • Experiência comprovada no setor administrativo‑financeiro em organizações da sociedade civil (altamente desejável)
  • Experiência com coordenação de equipes
  • Experiência com prestação de contas para agências das Nações Unidas (desejável)
  • Experiência com elaboração, execução, prestação de contas e auditoria de projetos nacionais e internacionais
  • Experiência com controles internos e bancários
  • Experiência com o sistema financeiro Ongsys ou outro sistema ERP (será diferencial)
  • Habilidades de colaboração, atenção aos detalhes, autonomia, organização, proatividade, bom relacionamento interpessoal e facilidade de trabalhar em equipe
  • Idiomas: Inglês (diferencial)

Contratação

  • Modalidade: CLT, por prazo indeterminado
  • Carga horária: 40 horas semanais
  • Salário: R$ 7.235,00 (bruto)
  • Benefícios: vale-transporte, vale-refeição ou alimentação, seguro de vida, day-off de aniversário, convênio com o SESC, Zenklub e Total Pass
  • Início: Setembro/25
  • Formato de trabalho: presencial no escritório no centro do Rio de Janeiro – RJ com flexibilidade para remoto (1x na semana)

Vaga

Enviar carta de apresentação, compartilhando o seu interesse e motivação em trabalhar na Empodera, + currículo para ****** , assunto: "VAGA Coordenação administrativa-financeira pleno". Prazo para envio de candidaturas: até 31/08/2025.

description:
Role Description

The Solution Architect leads one or more workstreams in complex enterprise customer engagements, partnering with key stakeholders to achieve the vision while executing on key deliverables. They serve as hands-on advisors, using strong interpersonal skills, solution and/or technical knowledge, Salesforce product knowledge, industry experience, consulting experience, and knowledge of their client’s business to deliver customer ROI.

Solution Architects are strong presenters and facilitators that are able to co-create the vision and lead the execution with the customer and obtain customer acceptance of the delivered solution. They are capable of driving difficult conversations and removing roadblocks to execute the business strategies. They are proficient at analyzing issues and obstacles to determine root cause, and can identify appropriate corrective action. They communicate with technical and business stakeholders from all levels through C-suite. On a day to day basis, they interact with customer product owners, business process owners and technical resources to understand requirements, analyze information, and design comprehensive solutions. They also show a strong understanding of typical business challenges or common objectives faced by customers within the industry.

Solution Architects are stewards of the Professional Services Methodology and use their networks to ensure that best practices are followed. They engage with Customer Success and Product teams to ensure the solutions are driving the most effective achievement of the value objectives. Solution Architects contribute to thought leadership and best practices by engaging with the cloud-specific practices teams. They will contribute both internally in their Community and externally in the marketplace.

Your Impact

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to the client
  • Identify and lead internal strategic initiatives to grow the consulting practice; serve as an active contributor to the community’s overall knowledge base and expertise
  • Guide customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies that drive increased business value
  • Work collaboratively and having very strong communications skills, especially in teaching complex concepts, and creative, prescriptive thinking across various levels of a client organization
  • Identify and proactively manage risk areas and commit to seeing an issue through to complete resolution
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Review and correct project/program direction, approach, and key artifacts to keep programs on track and solutions extendable and maintainable going forward
  • Drive a program vision while advising and articulating program/project strategies to enable technologies including the Salesforce platform

Minimum Requirements

  • 5+ years of relevant experience in enterprise-level projects using both waterfall and agile software development methodologies throughout the whole life cycle with repeated and demonstrable success
  • Extensive experience with configuration and customization on the Salesforce platform
  • Expert level experience defining the system architecture landscape, identifying gaps between current and desired end-states, and delivering a comprehensive solution that will enable achievement of the desired business outcomes
  • Experience leading discovery sessions, defining business requirements, writing user stories and providing detailed system and functional designs
  • Experience in documenting business processes and wire-framing system designs using process flow diagram tools, UML, sequence diagrams, etc. as well as making recommendations for future state improved processes and system designs
  • Strong presentation skills; able to effectively present a point of view and clearly articulate the rationale to a variety of stakeholders
  • Detail-oriented individual with the ability to rapidly learn and take advantage of new concepts, business models, and technologies
  • Strong communication skills, both written and verbal; able to effectively develop materials that are appropriate for the audience
  • Must be a team player as demonstrated through a customer qualification of a large scale/enterprise implementation with multiple work streams
  • A great listener with the ability to communicate with people in diverse roles
  • Resourceful and innovative thinker who can work through and solve problems
  • Possible travel of about 25%, but exact travel requirements will vary based on customer.

Preferred Requirements

  • Proven results in delivering high value business outcomes utilizing an agile approach
  • Proven results leading customer and/or partner success stories
  • Relevant Salesforce certifications and consulting experience are strongly recommended

Wellhub (formerly Gympass*) is a corporate wellness platform that connects employees to the best partners for fitness, mindfulness, therapy, nutrition, and sleep, all included in one subscription designed to cost less than each individual partner. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in NYC, we have a growing global team in 11 countries. At Wellhub, you have the opportunity to build a career in a high-growth tech company that places wellbeing at the foundation of its culture, and contribute to making every company a wellness company.

*Big news: Gympass is now Wellhub!

We are thrilled to announce our rebranding as Wellhub, marking a significant milestone in our journey. This transformation reflects our evolution from a “pass for gyms” to a comprehensive employee wellbeing solution. With our refreshed identity, we are poised to embark on an exciting new chapter of growth and expansion. We are elevating our offerings, including a completely new app experience and an expanded network of wellbeing partners. Learn more about it here.

THE OPPORTUNITY

We are hiring a Senior Data Scientist in our Generative AI area in Brazil ! This is a Remote – Brazil position, meaning you can work from anywhere within the country. Please note that this role is only open to candidates in Brazil.

YOUR IMPACT

  • Multimodal Extraction : Apply state-of-the-art tools (OCR, vision-language models, document understanding frameworks) to interpret diverse input types;
  • Prompt Engineering : Develop and refine strategies for using LLMs to extract, summarize, and transform unstructured content into structured formats;
  • Data Quality & Structuring : Clean, validate, and transform messy, unstructured data into well-defined schemas ready for use in training or analytics pipelines;
  • Content Filtering : Define standards and build systems for cleaning, validating, and filtering data to ensure accuracy, reduce bias, and align with ethical/safety guidelines;
  • Human-in-the-Loop Feedback : Design feedback loops where experts validate or enrich data, improving LLM-based extraction reliability;
  • Scalability & Optimization : Architect cost-efficient, high-throughput data pipelines that are robust to noisy or incomplete sources;
  • Research & Prototyping : Experiment with emerging tools and methods in the LLM + multimodal space, exploring new ways to enhance information coverage and extraction reliability;
  • Collaboration : Partner with data engineers and other data scientists to integrate collected data into larger AI and analytics systems;
  • Live the mission : inspire and empower others by genuinely caring for your own wellbeing and your colleagues. Bring wellbeing to the forefront of work, and create a supportive environment where everyone feels comfortable taking care of themselves, taking time off, and finding work-life balance.

WHO YOU ARE

  • Master’s degree (or PhD) in Computer Science, Data Science, Machine Learning, Statistics, or a related field;
  • Proficiency in Python and experience with libraries for web scraping, OCR (e.g., Tesseract, EasyOCR), and NLP (e.g., HuggingFace Transformers);
  • Deep understanding of LLM capabilities in multimodal and extraction contexts, including prompt engineering and few-shot learning;
  • Strong background in unstructured data processing: APIs, web scraping, HTML parsing, OCR, image/document analysis;
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills, with a track record of turning noisy data into high-quality datasets for ML;
  • Excellent communication and documentation skills, with the ability to influence across technical and product teams.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Familiarity with visual-language models (e.g., BLIP, Donut, or LayoutLM) and multimodal pipelines;
  • Hands-on experience in prompt engineering and few-shot learning for data extraction tasks;
  • Experience deploying or supporting data acquisition systems in production environments.

WHAT WE OFFER YOU

We're a wellness company that is committed to the health and wellbeing of our employees. Our flexible program allows you to customize your benefits, according to your needs!

Our benefits include:

WELLHUB: We believe in our mission and encourage our employees and their families to take care of their wellbeing too. About GrowthX AI

At GrowthX, we've redefined what AI-powered growth means for modern marketing teams. Since launching in 2024, we've grown from concept to eight-figure annual revenue. To date, we've raised a $12M Series A led by Madrona Venture Group and we partner with 50+ companies ranging from high-growth startups to industry leaders like Surge AI, Loveable, Webflow, Ramp, Superhuman, Strapi, Abnormal Security, and Homebase.

Our philosophy is simple: AI should serve experts, not replace them. We're not just building software. We're building the growth infrastructure that marketing teams wish they'd always had.

About The Role

The Account Director is accountable for ensuring every customer achieves measurable growth every quarter.

You own outcomes — not activity. You drive real results that customers care about: increased traffic, improved search and AI visibility, stronger conversions, and tangible pipeline impact.

You’ll lead a team of Strategists and Editors, ensuring they deliver consistent excellence without needing you in every conversation. You’ll set the playbook, remove blockers, develop talent, and intervene only when your experience is needed most.

You’ll stay closely involved with our most strategic customers, using your judgment to know when to step in and when to let your team lead. Ultimately, you own the numbers: retention, quality, growth, and customer success.

Who You Are

  • Outcome-Driven Leader: You’ve personally driven measurable growth — traffic, rankings, conversions — and know what actually works.
  • Strategic Operator: You can zoom out to define the strategy and zoom in when high-stakes execution demands your attention.
  • Systems Thinker: You turn insights into playbooks that scale across accounts and teams.
  • Talent Developer: You build teams that think strategically and connect every action to customer outcomes.
  • Decisive and Pragmatic: You act quickly on what matters and avoid unnecessary complexity or process theater.
  • Accountable: You own results. When retention or performance dips, you take responsibility — and fix it fast.

  • Are highly organized, detail-driven, and great at managing competing priorities.
  • Thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments and love building from scratch.
  • Are intellectually curious, and have heavily experimented with or implemented AI and automation tools in your daily work.
  • Can do the work yourself. We don’t want someone who points at other people to get things done.

What you’ll do

  • Drive Customer Outcomes
    • Ensure every account has a clear, measurable growth plan.
    • Review performance metrics (traffic, rankings, AI visibility, conversions) regularly.
    • Double down on winning strategies and cut losing efforts quickly.

    • Teach strategic thinking — not just task execution.
    • Remove barriers before they become emergencies.
    • Identify and address performance or fit issues decisively.
    • Create a culture of accountability, learning, and customer obsession.

Desenvolvedor ABAP Form Sênior | Remoto | PJ

Projeto ABAP com vigência até 31/03/2026.

O(a) Desenvolvedor ABAP Form Sênior será responsável pela criação, manutenção e otimização de formulários SAP utilizando tecnologias como SmartForms, SAPScript e Adobe Forms.

Atuará em estreita colaboração com as equipes funcionais e técnicas, garantindo que as especificações dos formulários estejam alinhadas aos requisitos fiscais, legais e operacionais da localização Brasil.

Além disso, apoiará projetos de implementação e sustentação em ambientes SAP ECC e S/4HANA, assegurando qualidade, desempenho e aderência às melhores práticas de desenvolvimento ABAP.

Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, ajustar e otimizar formulários SAP (SmartForms, SAPScript e Adobe Forms).
  • Realizar análise técnica a partir de especificações funcionais e definir soluções alinhadas às necessidades do negócio.
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com consultores funcionais de módulos como FI, SD, MM e CO para garantir correta integração dos formulários.
  • Implementar melhorias e correções em formulários fiscais e operacionais (NF-e, DANFE, boletos, pedidos, ordens de compra, relatórios financeiros).
  • Garantir aderência aos padrões de governança de código e naming conventions SAP.
  • Realizar testes unitários e integrados, assegurando a qualidade das entregas.
  • Apoiar o time técnico em análises de performance e debugging ABAP.
  • Documentar todas as alterações e desenvolvimentos técnicos conforme os padrões de projeto.

Requisitos

  • Experiência mínima de 5 anos com desenvolvimento ABAP focado em formulários.
  • Domínio em SmartForms, SAPScript e Adobe Forms.
  • Conhecimento em saídas fiscais e documentos legais da localização Brasil (NF-e, DANFE, SPED).
  • Capacidade de interpretar especificações funcionais e traduzi-las em soluções técnicas.
  • Vivência em projetos SAP ECC e/ou S/4HANA.
  • Inglês técnico (leitura e escrita).

Desejáveis

  • Experiência em OData, CDS Views e ABAP OO.
  • Conhecimento em ALV, BAPIs, BADIs e User Exits.
  • Experiência em migração de formulários SAP ECC → S/4HANA (Adobe Forms).
  • Noções de Git, SolMan ou ferramentas de versionamento ABAP.

Benefícios

  • Cartão ECXPAY no valor de R$ 500,00/Mês.
  • Acesso a Wellhub.
  • Convênio Zenklub - Psicólogo / Nutricionista / Coaching/ Terapia.
  • 22 dias de suspensão de serviços remunerados sem que isso afete a sua contraprestação mensal depois de 1 ano de empresas.
  • Parceria com curso de línguas "Time Load".
  • Parceria com clínica bridges.

Microsoft 365 is the fastest‑growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always‑up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns.   • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.

title: Technical Architect
description:
As a Salesforce Technical Architect Comunications , The Technical Architect is responsible for successfully designing and managing the delivery of complex Salesforce solutions for our customers.

You are both a big picture thinker and in-depth problem solver, your knowledge and skills are both broad and deep. You take pride in designing systems that stand up to high volumes and won't fail at critical points. You have a good mix of technical and enterprise skills when it comes to architecting a solution. The solutions you design are built for the long-term and will scale with the customer's growth plans seamlessly. You have proven experience integrating systems via API’s as well as a strong development background

Key Responsibilities

  • Solution Architecture: Lead technical design sessions and translate complex business requirements into well-architected solutions that leverage the Salesforce platform and its various products, SFI Industries, APEX and Omnistudio
  • Technical Leadership: You might lead a team of developers guiding them though the best practices, providing them an end to end vision, value driven scalable solutions, your solutions include but are not necessarily limited to Salesforce products, APIs, Lightning Experience & Component development, Apex/Visualforce, mobile development technologies, and integration middleware/ETL technologies.
  • Release & DevOps Management: Lead/manage the technical delivery of custom development, integrations, and data migrations. You will contribute to establish and manage DevOps strategies, including CI/CD pipelines, version control (GIT ), and environment management for large-scale implementations.
  • Project Collaboration: Collaborate with client stakeholders to define requirements, set expectations, and identify gaps between their current and desired states. You will also participate in pre-sales activities such as discovery sessions and Proof-Of-Concept (POC) development.
  • System Integration: Architect and manage integrations with external systems via APIs and ETL technologies. You should have a strong background in designing and building large web-based systems.
  • Problem-Solving: Proactively debug and resolve complex technical issues as they arise, applying a deep understanding of the project and its components.
  • Salesforce Liaison: Work with Salesforce product teams to support client implementations and ensure solutions align with platform best practices.
  • Travel: Be prepared for travel to client sites, averaging approximately 50% of the time, to collaborate effectively with global teams and stakeholders.

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Experience: 9+ years of experience as a technical architect, with at least 6+ years on the Salesforce platform.
  • Platform Expertise: Expert-level understanding of the Salesforce product suite, including Sales, Service, Analytics, and Experience Clouds, with OmniStudio and SFI knowledge being a plus.
  • Architectural Knowledge: Deep understanding of systems architecture, key design and integration patterns, and best practices for managing large data volumes. You should also be familiar with platform authentication patterns (SAML, SSO, OAuth ).
  • Development Background: Strong background in designing and developing large web-based systems, including a comprehensive understanding of the full software product lifecycle.
  • DevOps & Release Management: Experience with environment management, release management, code versioning, and deployment methodologies.
  • Security & Data: Familiarity with platform security capabilities (TLS, SSL ) and data sharing/visibility models.
  • Soft Skills: Be a proactive and self-managed professional with the ability to challenge the status quo and propose creative yet well-thought-out solutions.
  • Required Certifications (3 or more):
    • Salesforce Certified Platform Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified App Builder
    • Salesforce Certified JavaScript Developer I
    • Salesforce Certified Administrator / Advanced Administrator
    • Salesforce Certified Omnistudio Developer
    • Salesforce Certified Application Architect
    • Salesforce Certified System Architect
  • English proficient

Nice to Have Skills

  • Prior experience in the Communications Cloud, Media Cloud salesforce industries.
  • Certifications: Active Salesforce certifications or the ability to achieve relevant certifications upon hire. Candidates with the Salesforce Application Architect or System Architect credentials are highly desirable.

ICEYE delivers space-based intelligence, surveillance, and reconnaissance (ISR) capabilities to governments and allied nations. This includes sovereign and turnkey ISR missions leveraging ICEYE's world‑leading synthetic aperture radar (SAR) satellite technology, as well as access to data from the world's largest SAR satellite constellation. These capabilities enable partners to detect and respond to critical changes anywhere on Earth with unprecedented speed and accuracy - day or night and in any weather, supported by ultra high‑resolution imagery and high‑frequency revisits.

As a trusted partner for defense, intelligence, security, and maritime domain awareness, ICEYE's near real‑time data creates a tactical advantage for mission‑critical operations. Designed for dual use, the platform also serves civil protection and commercial users for natural‑catastrophe intelligence, insurance, maritime monitoring (including oil‑spill detection), and finance, contributing to global security and community resilience.

ICEYE operates internationally with offices in Finland, Poland, Spain, Japan, the UAE, Greece, and the US. The company has more than 900 employees, inspired by the shared vision of improving life on Earth by becoming the global source of truth in Earth Observation.

Expected outcomes & Competencies

  • Develop and qualify the Northern LATAM market for ICEYE's sovereign and turnkey ISR missions
  • Define and execute a regional Go‑To‑Market strategy, grounded in structured market intelligence to inform ICEYE's global Missions strategy, prioritize target markets, and guide resource allocation
  • Initiate and lead at least three strategic ISR sales campaigns in the first year
  • Grow and develop a multi‑year satellite sales pipeline ), establishing a sustainable foundation for long‑term growth and recurring government partnerships across the region
  • Establish ICEYE as a recognized ISR leader and trusted partner in Northern LATAM through consistent engagement with government institutions, local primes, and industry events
  • Drive collaboration with ICEYE's Data and Solutions sales teams to identify and close integrated ISR and data opportunities, ensuring coherent positioning and value creation across product lines

Role‑specific competences

  • 5+ years of sales experience within the Aerospace, Defense or Space industry
  • 5+ years of International sales export experience
  • 5+ years experience with earth observation, preferably SAR
  • Existing network to all levels of Government and Government Organisations in your market.
  • Experience in executing complex strategic sales thinking and the application of professional sales processes.
  • Proven experience in managing high‑level relationships with MoDs, Air Forces, and Space Agencies
  • Ability to speak the local language

Missions key competences

  • Intellectual Firepower: Rapidly comprehends, structures and synthesizes complex information, draws accurate conclusions, and communicates them with clarity.
  • Passion & Work Ethic: Brings sustained motivation, resilience, and high personal standards to every challenge.
  • Ownership & Action: Assumes full accountability for outcomes, acting decisively, and ensuring commitments are delivered.
  • Team Player: Works collaboratively across teams, contributing to shared success, and engaging in constructive debate.
  • Integrity & Growth Mindset: Operates with transparency and humility, learns from setbacks, and actively seeks opportunities to grow.

Benefits

  • A job that matters in a dynamic Defence Technology and Earth Observation environment with a scale‑up approach
  • An independent role with a supportive and diverse work environment
  • Time for self‑development, research, training, conferences, or certification schemes
  • Base salary range for this position is contingent on your experience level, and will be negotiated individually.

Our commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion

At ICEYE, we believe that diversity isn't just a buzzword - it's our greatest asset.

We're committed to fostering an inclusive environment where every voice is not only heard but celebrated. We know that diverse perspectives breed innovation and creativity, which is why we actively seek out individuals from all walks of life, backgrounds, and experiences.

Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. Join us and be part of a team where differences are not only embraced but cherished, because together, we're stronger.

  • Consolidar informações e preparar materiais para o Demand Review Meeting.
  • Manter registro formal de premissas, riscos e decisões tomadas.
  • Suportar auditorias e revisões de governança sobre o processo de S&OP.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo Engenharia, Administração, Economia, Estatística, Sistema de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

  • Conhecimento e prática nas auditorias do mercado farmacêutico: IQVIA e Close UP.
  • Noções de finanças e custos operacionais e gestão de estoque.

  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de BI (Power BI, Tableau), Alteryx.

Somos uma empresa PLURAL ! Diversidade e inclusão estão na pauta constante da MAG. Nos orgulhamos de ser uma companhia formada por mais de 80% de colaboradores pertencentes a pelo menos um grupo minorizado. Contamos com o Plural, programa formal, estruturado e direcionado ao fomento da diversidade e inclusão.

Na MAG temos o forte propósito de oferecer soluções financeiras nos diversos momentos de vida de todos os brasileiros. No Brasil temos quase 200 anos de atuação ininterrupta e fazemos parte do Grupo Aegon.

  • Experiência comercial e com rotina de vendas externas;

title: Director, Client Results
description:
Director, Client Results

Director, Client Results

This position will provide leadership and direction for the day-to-day operations of account(s). The Client Results Account Director is responsible for overall operations and operational performance.

The Purpose of Your Role

Responsible for management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. Client Results Director will develop, initiate, and determine performance strategies to enhance execution to maximize results. He / she will work cross-functionally to create, implement, and optimize all necessary support initiatives, identify opportunities. Leadership will need to be tactical with a key emphasis on maximizing KPI, customer care, quality assurance, workforce planning, recruiting, coaching, and training.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years of work experience required
  • 10 years of contact center/BPO experience
  • 5 years prior multi-level management experience
  • Proven demonstrable track record of success
  • Team player able to collaborate with cross-functional teams
  • Exceptional interpersonal skills in a team environment
  • Experience with interacting and influencing clients’ outcomes
  • Executive Presence
  • Strong Organizational, multi-tasking, time management skills
  • Travel up to 25% when it’s safe to travel

The Competencies You Bring

Strategic Thinking, P&L Ownership, Dealing with Ambiguity, Decision Making, Negotiating, Results Orientation

The Value You Deliver

Development and Execution of Strategic Account Plan

  • Responsible for overall success of program(s) and account health
  • Define and manage metrics, ensure customer satisfaction, and report statistical performance levels to appropriate groups
  • Escalation point of contact for Client contacts
  • Develop customer communication strategies
    • Establish and communicate the service standards to the operations team so that quality customer satisfaction is achieved
    • Develop strong Client partnerships
  • Account Plans
    • Build relationships at all levels
      • Ensure multi-level coverage
    • Strategize the planning, developing, and directing of the customer service program
  • Growth and Profitability Strategies
    • Coordinate analytic, strategic, and technical resources to meet client expectations and ensure satisfaction
    • Foster and create business innovation to drive increased performance and adoption
    • Lead multiple projects at once and ensure strong integration across the organization
    • Ensure Managers and Agent Results Advocates are trained on all aspects of platforms and reporting, which will require research tools, as well as excellent writing and presentation skills

Responsible for account P&L

  • Entire book of business and individual accounts
  • Identify additional revenue streams within install base

Promote active agent engagement and advancement

  • Attrition rates, incentives and rewards, Statement of Work adherence, quality, communication
  • Implement performance optimization strategies to further improve agent productivity and performance

Business Calibration

  • Drive cross-functional calibration with support functions and teams, e.g. (Workforce Management, Professional Services, Talent Acquisition and Onboarding)
  • Regular touch points with Clients, Directors, Managers, Agent Results Advocates & Agents
  • Manage up to VP and Leadership
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Client Results Team and Cross Functional Teams

Employee Management

  • Day-to-day management of resources, including sourcing, coaching, performance management and employee development
  • Responsible for succession planning
  • Foster a productive and empowering work environment
  • Mentor and develop his/her team and direct them in finding creative solutions for both Client and internal challenges, foster knowledge-sharing across all verticals internally to ensure collaborative and informed work
  • Provide team with necessary tools and training to improve core expertise and continued career growth

Budget Support

  • Execute against established annual department budget to attain business goals with operational stability

Additional Sr Director Requirements

The Senior Director of Client Results is responsible for overall operations and operational performance. The Senior Director will be the senior point of contact for day-to-day management of the business; the ability to offer solutions and new ideas to promote program success, revenue growth, and profitability. He/she will be responsible for overseeing the management and coordination of various support functions and activities for accounts. The Senior Client Results Director will direct and supervise the development and execution of performance strategies to maximize results.

  • 6 years prior multi-level management experience

Development and Execution of Strategic Account Plan

  • Perform senior-level Client negotiation and management skills, with clear and substantive speaking, writing, and presentation skills
  • Develop customer communication strategies
    • Senior point of contact for senior Client contacts and escalations
  • Develop Trusted Adviser partnerships at the senior-level
  • Account Plans
    • Direct and supervise initiatives and deliverables in Account Plans
  • Growth and Profitability Strategies
    • Direct analytic, strategic and technical resources to meet client expectations and ensure satisfaction
    • Oversee multiple projects at once and ensure strong integration across the organization
    • Ensure Directors and Managers are trained on all aspects of applications and reporting; which will require research tools, as well as excellent writing and presentation skills

Promote active agent engagement and advancement

  • Oversee attrition rates, incentives and rewards, Statement of Work adherence, quality, communication
  • Direct performance optimization strategies to further improve agent productivity and performance

Business Calibration

  • Serve as Client Results advocate and liaison for company-wide projects and initiatives

Employee Management

  • Developing bench strength within the team directly and by creating a culture of professional development
  • Responsible for succession planning with Directors and Managers, and oversee succession planning for Agent Results Advocates
  • Create an effective process and information flow between Directors and Managers
  • Demonstrates additional competencies Business Acumen, External (Strategic) Awareness & Organizational Awareness

About Liveops

Liveops is a virtual call center offering an on-demand skilled workforce of onshore virtual agents for all customer service and sales needs.

With more than 20 years of experience offering flexibility, scalable talent and meaningful work, Liveops has been improving the lives of its agents, clients, and employees by creating endless opportunity. Our virtual-flex model has enabled more than 400 organizations across service industries including retail, healthcare, insurance, tax, telecom, and government to trust Liveops to deliver a fully scalable enterprise workforce, with faster program readiness, increased revenue, and greater customer satisfaction scores than traditional call centers.

Liveops exists to improve the lives of our agents, clients and employees. As a Liveops employee, you’re part of a purpose-driven culture that values curiosity, collaboration, and results. We encourage diverse perspectives to create better outcomes, celebrate initiative, and build relationships based on trust and transparency. We offer outstanding benefits including insurance, 401k match and a flexible vacation plan.

Eligibility Requirements

Legal authorization is required to work in the U.S. is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas now or in the future.

title: Country Manager - Brazil
description:
Overview

Country Manager - Brazil role at Bitso Brasil .

As Bitso’s Country Manager for Brazil, you will be the face of our business in one of the most important markets in Latin America. This role is at the heart of Bitso’s mission: making crypto useful and accessible to millions of people. You will ensure our global strategies are adapted to local needs, lead regulatory and corporate affairs, build relationships with customers and partners, and help drive business growth. This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of the crypto ecosystem in Brazil, working with a high-impact team across Latin America.

What You Will Do

  • Act as Bitso’s primary spokesperson in Brazil with media, regulators, clients, partners, and the community.
  • Lead market intelligence efforts, providing ongoing insights about customer behavior, competitors, regulation, and the economy.
  • Translate local insights into actionable go-to-market strategies in close collaboration with Bitso’s global Retail and Business teams.
  • Represent Bitso before regulators and serve as legal representative for regulated entities in Brazil.
  • Build strong relationships with government authorities, regulators, and industry associations.
  • Champion customer needs locally, ensuring Bitso’s global product suite delivers a seamless and relevant experience for Brazilian users.
  • Support Bitso Business (B2B) and Retail growth by engaging with strategic clients, partners, and influencers.
  • Drive community engagement by collaborating with Marketing and Comms teams to design and execute local events and campaigns.
  • Actively contribute to regional and global planning, ensuring Brazil’s perspective and needs are included in company-wide strategies.

Who You Are

  • Proven track record in building and leading teams, preferably in fintech, crypto, payments, or financial services.
  • Strong understanding of the Brazilian regulatory and financial ecosystem, including relationships with regulators, banks, payment institutions, and fintech associations.
  • Experience as a public spokesperson, with demonstrable success engaging with media, regulators, and senior stakeholders.
  • Strategic business development background, with experience negotiating partnerships and supporting sales pipelines.
  • Ability to synthesize complex local trends into actionable strategies and communicate them clearly to global leadership.
  • Experience working cross-functionally in regional or global organizations, balancing local priorities with global objectives.
  • Legal and compliance awareness, able to act as legal representative with personal accountability.
  • Excellent communication skills in Portuguese and English (Spanish desirable).
  • Entrepreneurial mindset, resilience, and passion for crypto and Bitso’s mission.

Your Team

You will collaborate closely with Bitso’s General Managers (Retail and Bitso Business), as well as global functions such as Policy, Product, Legal, Finance, and Operations.

Who We Are

With over 9 million users, Bitso is the leading cryptocurrency platform in Latin America. We are developing the cryptocurrency ecosystem in the region and enabling financial inclusion. We believe crypto is the future of finance, and we’re committed to making it useful by providing equal access to safe and intuitive financial products.

When we hire people for our team, we specifically test for the following traits in addition to our cultural values:

  • Mission-Driven: We seek individuals who are passionate about crypto and Bitso’s mission and resilient in facing industry challenges
  • High Sense of Urgency: We prioritize candidates who demonstrate a high sense of urgency and responsibility.
  • Exceptional Hard Skills: We seek individuals who possess exceptional skills in their respective fields, with no room for mediocrity.
  • Self-Management: We look for individuals who can independently manage their work, career, and professional development.

Compensation & Benefits

At Bitso, you are taking the front seat on the edge of crypto innovation, creating the next generation of crypto-powered products. So for those willing to commit, adapt and pioneer the most important change of the century we offer:

  • Me Time program, including unlimited paid time off.
  • Remote-first work environment.
  • Employee Stock Option program.
  • Zero trading fees through our Bitso Alpha app.
  • Extended Family Leave Policy: all birthing parents, non-birthing parents and adopting parents are eligible for a 4-months leave.
  • Premium health, dental and life insurances in Mexico, Gibraltar, Colombia, USA, Brazil and Argentina.
  • Monthly stipend for gym memberships, relaxation activities, sports equipment, cooking classes, books, entertainment and more.

title: Senior Software Engineer - M365
description:
We are hiring multiple Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home!

Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft.

Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you!

We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond‑level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest‑growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up‑to‑date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high‑scale, low‑latency, always‑on, and cost‑effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation‑only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large‑scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well‑tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on‑call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering or equivalent experience.
  • At least 5 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 5+ years of hands‑on experience in an object‑oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well‑tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self‑motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. Consistent with applicable law, all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. description:
Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer

Join to apply for the Software Engineer II / Senior Software Engineer role at Microsoft

We are hiring multiple Software Engineers II and Senior Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from home. The Microsoft 365 team is looking for software engineers to help design and build one of the fastest-growing cloud services at Microsoft. Do you want to work on a product that ships new features every week? If so, the Microsoft 365 team would love to hear from you!

We build and operate the largest enterprise cloud productivity system in the world. Across products such as Exchange, Teams, and SharePoint, we power communication, sharing, search, intelligent assistance, extensibility through Microsoft Graph, and more. We maintain high reliability and availability, strong privacy and compliance, and millisecond-level latency. Our work combines approaches from API design, machine learning, distributed computing, workflow engines, algorithm optimization, and more. Join us to define, design, and deliver what enterprise cloud productivity means.

More About Microsoft 365

Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up-to-date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

More About Your Responsibilities

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high-scale, low-latency, always-on, and cost-effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns. Strong partnership and influence skills are essential, along with motivation and the ability to collaborate across teams.

By applying to this position, you will be considered for multiple similar positions within our organization for an invitation-only virtual interview day. Position specifics, including hiring team, location, and position details, will be determined following the interview process.

Responsibilities

  • Drive projects through to delivery, removing obstacles to ensure success.
  • Contribute to the design of large-scale distributed software services and solutions.
  • Write clean, well-tested code.
  • Champion and improve team software engineering practices.
  • Mentor junior engineers.
  • Collaborate with related teams to achieve goals.
  • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

Main Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 3 years of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in an object-oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well-tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

title: Creative Director
description:
Overview

Job Title: Creative Director (Marketing Agency)

Type: Full Time Remote

Working Hours: Mondays - Fridays 9:00 am - 5:00 pm CST

Compensation: $3000 - $3800 USD (based on experience)

Location: LATAM (All locations - remote)

About The Company
Our client is a dynamic digital advertising and marketing automation agency, where a consultative, hands-on approach drives exceptional results. They are experts in digital advertising and CRM, dedicated to improving our clients' return on ad spend. Working across diverse industries, they provide innovative solutions and leverage cutting-edge tools and platforms to help businesses thrive. Be part of a team that's passionate about delivering impactful marketing strategies and achieving measurable success.

The Opportunity

We are seeking a versatile and highly skilled Creative Director to serve as the key creative engine supporting our agency’s diverse marketing and advertising needs. This role is ideal for a hands-on designer who thrives in a fast-paced environment and possesses the technical fluency to create highly effective content optimized for various digital platforms.

You will be responsible for conceptualizing and producing high-quality visual assets that drive engagement and conversion across all client and internal channels.

Key Responsibilities

  • Content & Asset Production: Paid Media Design – Design and format compelling visual content (static images, basic animations) specifically optimized for placement on major advertising channels, including Meta (Facebook/Instagram), Google, and X (Twitter).
  • Short-Form Video: Produce and edit engaging short-form video content for organic and paid placement across platforms like TikTok, YouTube Shorts, and Meta Reels.
  • Email Marketing: Design visually appealing and high-converting email templates and graphics for marketing automation campaigns.
  • Design Tool Mastery: Utilize tools like Canva, Figma, and Photoshop with exceptional skill to maintain brand consistency and deliver production-ready creative assets on time.

Web Design & Technical Aptitude

  • Web/Landing Page Design: Create clean, functional, and aesthetically pleasing web and landing page designs (UX/UI planning and mockups), focusing on client conversion goals. Note: Direct web development (coding) is not required, but proficiency in web development is a significant advantage.
  • Creative Optimization (Bonus Skills): Utilize familiarity with principles of SEO and Conversion Rate Optimization (CRO) to inform design choices, ensuring all produced content is positioned for maximum performance.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a comparable multi-client role, specifically serving the U.S. market.
  • Design Proficiency: Exceptional, proven skills in Canva, Figma, and Adobe Photoshop for both rapid content creation and polished, detailed design work.
  • Platform-Specific Design: Demonstrated understanding of the content specifications and best practices for advertising and organic placement on Meta, Google, and short-form video platforms.
  • Experience in producing and editing engaging short-form video assets.
  • Versatility: Proven ability to manage and switch contexts between high-volume ad creative, detailed email graphics, and web design projects.
  • Communication: Strong ability to take creative direction and translate marketing objectives into effective visual solutions.

Nice-to-Have

  • Experience or deep technical knowledge in SEO and/or CRO.
  • Basic to advanced web development (coding) skills.
  • Up-to-date education or professional certifications in design, digital marketing, brand strategy, or digital media production.
